en.headline: Police and firefighters bust suspected triad illegal petrol station in Sha Tau Kok
en.dek: Officers seized about 2,400 litres of petrol worth roughly HK$90,000 near homes and will prosecute a 58-year-old man for fire safety and dangerous goods offences.
body: Police and the Fire Services Department dismantled a suspected triad-run illegal petrol station on Sha Tau Kok Road on Thursday, seizing about 2,400 litres of petrol with a market value of about HK$90,000.

The Border District crime unit and the Fire Services Department’s special task force against illegal fuel transfer found a large number of refuelling tools and intercepted a 58-year-old man at the site.

Police said the man is suspected of operating the station in contravention of the Fire Safety (Fire Hazards) Regulations, the Dangerous Goods Ordinance and the Dangerous Goods (Control) Regulations, and will be prosecuted.

The Fire Services Department has taken the petrol away and will apply to the court for confiscation. The station was near residential buildings and lacked dedicated fire safety installations, posing a serious safety threat to nearby residents in the event of a fire.
Police and the Fire Services Department said they would continue joint enforcement against illegal fuel transfer activities.

zh.headline: 警消搞破沙頭角懷疑三合會非法加油站 拖58歲男將檢控
zh.dek: 執法人員檢獲約2400公升市值約9萬元汽油，站址鄰近民居且缺乏消防設備，對附近居民構成嚴重安全威脅。
body: 警方邊界警區刑事部周四聯同消防處打擊非法燃油轉注特遣隊，在沙頭角路搞破一個懷疑由三合會操控的非法加油站，檢獲約2400公升汽油，市值約9萬元。
行動中發現大批入油工具，並截查一名58歲男子，涉嫌營運非法加油站。
警方指，該名男子涉嫌違反《消防（消除火警危險）規例》、《危險品條例》及《危險品（管制）規例》，將會被檢控。
消防處已檢走涉案汽油，並會向法庭申請充公。該站鄰近民居，未有裝設專用消防裝置及設備，一旦發生火警，將對周邊市民及建築物構成嚴重安全威脅。
警方與消防處表示會繼續採取執法行動，打擊非法燃油轉注活動。
